verdict.rationale: LlamaParse documents a full REST API with SDKs in multiple languages, a live OpenAPI spec confirmed via runtime probe, webhooks, and an MCP endpoint exposing Parse/Extract/Classify/Split/Index as callable tools — strong evidence of a documented, agent-drivable public API. missing for 10: independent third-party developer testimonials specifically about API usage (vs. general product reviews), and a publicly browsable interactive API reference/playground.
